## Delivery checklist

- [ ] Linked the issue and used descriptive commits.
- [ ] Updated PROJECT_LOG.md with the date, decision and evidence.
- [ ] Updated README / extension/CHANGELOG.md where behavior changed.
- [ ] Build, tests and packaging pass; untested requirements are listed above.
- [ ] No credentials, dependencies, generated output or private work material in the diff.
- [ ] Ready for a merge commit to main, preserving implementation history.
